correction_scope: Remove synthetic 21:00 UTC event times assigned to daily ETF holdings rows. The source pages identify trading dates, not exact event timestamps. Separate issuer-file timestamps from page retrieval time.

field_corrections.reason: XRP Insights reports the November 4 trading-day holdings row; the page does not expose an exact event timestamp for the row.
CryptoKeyhole identifies the November 3 trading day; 21:00 UTC was a synthetic session-close timestamp, not a source-provided event time.
03:04 UTC is the Bitwise issuer-file stamp shown by CryptoKeyhole, not the time the page was checked. The other displayed issuer-file stamps belong to separate funds.
Alpha Finance reports a November 3 daily row; it does not expose an exact row event timestamp.

source_timestamp_policy.daily_holdings_rows: Store the issuer/trading date as a date. Do not synthesize 21:00 UTC or another close time unless the source explicitly provides it.
source_timestamp_policy.issuer_file_timestamps: Store per-fund publication/issuer-stamp times separately from page retrieval time.
source_timestamp_policy.retrieval_time: Unknown unless the retrieval system records a per-request timestamp. A page crawl or issuer file stamp is not a substitute.

interpretation: The holdings values and flow calculations are not changed. Only unsupported timestamp precision is removed. The original snapshot remains preserved; a canonical consumer must apply these exact field corrections before any point-in-time use.
next_action: Extend the correction-overlay admission adapter to apply date-only event-time corrections and reject synthetic timestamps.
